about: Experienced Software Engineer with 5+ years of expertise in backend systems, distributed architectures, and cloud-native solutions. Senior Bar Raiser / Key Interviewer at Oracle, recognized for upholding technical excellence and guiding high-quality hiring decisions. Proven ability to design scalable systems in healthcare, education, and finance domains using Java, Python, Kafka, and OCI/AWS. Specialized in machine learning, applying techniques such as anomaly detection and generative AI to solve real-world problems and enhance system intelligence. Passionate about mentoring juniors, solving complex problems, and driving product impact through innovative technologies and continuous learning.

Architected and implemented mro-gen-services, a Java Micronaut-based solution for generating medical record outputs.

Resolved technical and scope ambiguities across multiple initiatives and contributed to early-stage architecture and planning for the SI DRZ region build and EHRC modernization program.
Built and led the India Clinical Reporting team.
